Name: shotwind
Source: startAct (human shot press, AI shot decision)
Note: drives p.act; the windup pose reads p.act, not this event

Name: passwind
Source: startAct (pass)

Name: actcancel
Source: tickAct when stunned, possession lost or game over
Note: only way a windup is cancelled

Name: shot
Source: shoot() at puck release

Name: pass
Source: pass() at puck release

Name: recv
Source: pass() for the intended receiver

Name: gain
Source: puck pickup / reception resolution (clean, difficult, bobble, deflect, miss)

Name: otwind
Source: AI one-timer detect; human one-timer press

Name: poke
Source: step() poke-check strip of the carrier

Name: hitwind
Source: human hit press (builds the lunge)

Name: hitcommit
Source: step() hit contact frame (human lunge reaches target)

Name: hitmiss
Source: step() hit lunge ends with no contact

Name: check
Source: step() hit resolution; fight exchanges

Name: checked
Source: step() hit resolution; fight exchanges

Name: fall
Source: step() hit (hard), injury, fight loser, trip penalty reaction

Name: hookv
Source: HITS.pen on a Hooking call (offline sim and client only)

Name: holdv
Source: HITS.pen on a Holding call

Name: slashv
Source: HITS.pen on a Slashing call

Name: interfv
Source: HITS.pen on an Interference call

Name: liftv
Source: HITS.onEvent after a poke that strips the carrier

Name: draw
Source: faceoff drop

Name: save
Source: step() save resolution

Name: cover
Source: step() save followed by a freeze; deferred until the save animation is over

Name: goalagainst
Source: goal() for the scored-on goalie

Name: poke_g
Source: goalieStep poke check at a close carrier (sent as AE kind poke on the goalie)

Name: pull
Source: step() when the coach pulls the goalie

Name: return
Source: step() when the goalie is put back

Name: idle
Source: not emitted by the sim; anim_goalie auto-generates during stoppage (c.gw.stop)

Name: celebrate
Source: goal() / net goal event -> CEL.onGoal sets p.celeb

Name: dejected
Source: CEL.onGoal (scored-on skaters) / CEL.onEnd (losers)

Name: win
Source: finish() / net showEnd -> CEL.onEnd
